title.ur: Jumper cap / connector jumper ki kharabi

meaning.en: Board jumper configuration missing, wrong, or connector jumper fault — often after control-board replacement without transferring jumper.
meaning.ur: Board par jumper configuration ghaib ya ghalat hai ya connector jumper kharab hai — aksar control board badalne ke baad jumper transfer na karne ki wajah se hota hai.

causes.en: Jumper not transferred when board replaced
causes.ur: Board badalte waqt jumper transfer nahi kiya gaya
Cap gayab hai ya ghalat jagah laga hai
Service ke baad pairing compatible nahi rahi

solutions.en: Transfer/install correct jumper on new board
solutions.ur: Naye board par sahi jumper transfer/install karein

solutions.en: Technician verifies configuration for the model
solutions.ur: Technician model ke liye configuration verify kare

notes.ur: Official C5 ke liye board replacement ke baad jumper transfer ko clearly document karta hai. Per-code attribution: official + multi-pk + heatpumpanswers.

title.en: PFC module high temperature or PFC sensor fault
title.ur: PFC module ka high temperature ya PFC sensor kharab

meaning.en: PFC stage overheated or its temperature sensor failed.
meaning.ur: PFC stage bohat garam ho gaya ya iska temperature sensor kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Power off and let the outdoor unit cool before opening it for inspection
solutions.ur: Power band karein aur outdoor unit ko inspect karne se pehle thanda hone dein

solutions.en: A technician checks the PFC temperature sensor and module and replaces whichever tests faulty
solutions.ur: Technician PFC temperature sensor aur module check kare aur jo kharab ho woh badle

meaning.en: Suction/inlet line temperature sensor open or short.
meaning.ur: Suction/inlet line ka temperature sensor khul ya short ho gaya.

causes.ur: NTC fail ho gaya ya wiring kharab hai

causes.en: Loose or corroded sensor connector at the board
causes.ur: Board par sensor ka connector dhila ya zang lagaya hua hai

causes.en: Harness damaged by heat or service work near the pipe
causes.ur: Harness ko garmi ya pipe ke paas service ke kaam ki wajah se nuksan hua

solutions.en: Isolate power and reseat the suction-line sensor connector, then check the wiring for damage
solutions.ur: Power isolate karke suction-line sensor ka connector dobara lagayein, phir wiring ki damage check karein

solutions.en: Measure resistance against the temperature chart and replace the sensor if it reads open or short
solutions.ur: Temperature chart se resistance naapein aur open/short de raha ho to sensor badlein

notes.ur: Is code ki attribution multi-pk hai.

meaning.en: Discharge/outlet line temperature sensor open or short.
meaning.ur: Discharge/outlet line ka temperature sensor khul ya short ho gaya.

causes.ur: NTC sensor ya uski wiring fail ho gayi

causes.en: Loose connector or burnt wiring at the sensor plug
causes.ur: Sensor plug par connector dhila hai ya wiring jal gayi

causes.en: Sensor tube damaged during service or from vibration
causes.ur: Service ya vibration ki wajah se sensor tube ko nuksan pahuncha

solutions.en: Disconnect power and inspect the discharge-line sensor connector and harness for looseness or burns
solutions.ur: Power disconnect karke discharge-line sensor ka connector aur harness dhilapan ya jale hone par check karein

solutions.en: Test resistance against the chart and replace the sensor if it reads out of range
solutions.ur: Chart se resistance test karein aur range se bahar aaye to sensor badlein

meaning.en: Official article: power protection activated, possibly after a significant power surge — requires professional assessment.
meaning.ur: Official article ke mutabiq power protection faal ho gaya, shayad bade power surge ke baad — professional check zaroori hai.

causes.ur: Power surge (current ka zorana) aaya tha

solutions.en: Disconnect the unit and have the mains supply checked before resetting it
solutions.ur: Unit disconnect karke reset se pehle mains supply check karwayein

solutions.en: A technician assesses the board and supply, then fit a proper stabilizer or surge protector
solutions.ur: Technician board aur supply ka assessment kare, phir sahi stabilizer ya surge protector lagwayein

title.en: Phase power lack / cooling-lamp family marker
title.ur: Ek phase ka power kam ya cooling lamp family marker

meaning.en: airconditioningmanuals narrative: missing phase power — check wiring. Also listed as cooling-indicator family (F0–F9, FF). Low independence.
meaning.ur: airconditioningmanuals ke mutabiq missing phase power — wiring check karein. Isay cooling-indicator family (F0–F9, FF) mein bhi rakha gaya hai. Kam qabil-e-aitmaad source hai.

causes.ur: Supply/wiring mein phase ka masla (sirf ek narrative source)

causes.en: One incoming phase absent at the outdoor supply
causes.ur: Outdoor supply mein se ek phase gayab hai

causes.en: Loose or burnt supply terminal, or a failed breaker pole
causes.ur: Supply terminal dhila ya jal gaya, ya ek pole ka breaker kharab hai

solutions.en: Isolate supply and check the incoming phases at the breaker with a meter
solutions.ur: Supply isolate karke breaker par meter se incoming phases check karein

solutions.en: Call an electrician to restore the missing phase or repair the supply wiring
solutions.ur: Electrician bulayein jo gayab phase wapas laye ya supply wiring theek kare
